xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: Related to : 1. Other Income: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (“ABHI”) has made a preferential allotment of 5,07,07,454 equity shares of Rs 10 each to Platinum Jasmine A 2018 Trust, acting through its trustee, Platinum Owl C 2018 RSC Limited, being a wholly owned subsidiary of Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA), on 21st October, 2022 for an aggregate consideration of Rs. 664.27 crore. Pursuant to such issuance of the equity shares, ADIA owns 9.99% stake in ABHI. W.e.f. 21st October 2022, ABCL holds 45.91% stake in ABHI. Consequently, ABHI ceased to be a subsidiary and has been accounted as a joint venture. This has resulted in fair value gain of Rs.2,739.07 crore representing difference between fair value of retained interest in ABHI and derecognition of net assets of ABHI in accordance with 'Ind AS 110 - Consolidated Financial Statements'. The gain has been included in Other income. As a result, Financial Results of Quarter and Nine Months Ended 31st December, 2022 are not comparable with previous periods. Related to : 1. Policyholders' income from life insurance operations 2. Policyholders' expense from Health insurance operations Since Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHI) has been accounted as Joint Venture w.e.f. 21st October 2022, Policyholder income and expense related to ABHI has been consolidtaed line by line in ABCL consolidated financials upto 20th October 2022.
